requirements.title: Complex raised to complex power has the principal value
requirements.definition: For a complex value raised to a complex power, the value of x1 ** x2 is the principal value of x1 raised to x2.

pending.complex-one-to-complex-power: PENDING source plan for (1.0,0.0) ** z with a complex exponent only if an exact principal-value oracle can be justified without depending on processor approximation details. Otherwise this finite witness remains pending.
pending.complex-base-complex-one-power: PENDING source plan for z ** (1.0,0.0) with small exact z, recording the interpretation as complex exponentiation while independently assessing whether the computational components are portably determined.
pending.principal-branch-boundary: PENDING source-only negative/contrast plan documenting that branch-sensitive cases such as negative real bases with noninteger complex exponents are not acceptable value oracles unless a portable principal-value result and computational tolerance-free representation can be derived.
pending.nonportable-approximation-boundary: PENDING reviewer plan to mark nontrivial complex-power numeric values as not portably determined where processor approximation, model arithmetic, or 10.1.5.2.4 rewriting can change components. Such cases may be source-admission controls only, not value oracles.

requirements.oracle: This subclause is especially sensitive to nonportable numeric values. Prefer type/admission and trivial exact identities only after independent justification; do not use tolerance, compiler agreement, or mathematically equivalent rewrites as a substitute for a portable principal-value oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal, inquiry, or source-relation oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or any numeric result that 10.1.5.2.4 permits to differ through mathematically equivalent rewriting. Floating-point tolerance is not an escape hatch for a value that is not portably determined.

review_rationale: batch101: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read every base unit of 10.1.5.2.1-10.1.5.2.4 and 10.1.5.3.1-10.1.5.3.2 in the original PDF, not the author summary, and verified 24 base / 42 fine units, 12 requirements and 45 facets (all pending), with 0 already-counted numbered units. Reviewer independently agreed with the zero-facet verdict for 10.1.5.3.2 (permission-only / oracle boundary, not absence of normative text) and with the handling of Tables 10.3 and 10.4 and the informative NOTE 2 alternative forms. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings; two non-blocking scope clarifications recorded as C10NR-NB1 and C10NR-NB2 in doc/source_audits/batch_101.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, not an execution result, and approves no concrete numeric or complex-power value oracle.
